# n8n node coverage

Ranked list: `docs/n8n-popular-nodes.txt` (136 node types, most used first).
**Implemented: 130 / 136** (96%). Generated by comparing that list with the node types
registered in `hk-flow` (core, AI), `hk-integrations` (hand-written + `specs/*.json`) and the plugin host.

## How integrations are built
* Core / AI / flow-control nodes: `crates/hk-flow/src/nodes`.
* Hand-written integrations (Slack, Telegram, GitHub, Postgres, Redis, S3, IMAP/SMTP, ...): `crates/hk-integrations/src/*.rs`.
* **Data-driven REST integrations**: one JSON file per service in `crates/hk-integrations/specs/` (resources, operations,
  path, where each parameter goes, pagination). `declarative.rs` expands it into the n8n node description and runs it on the
  shared REST engine; `tests/declarative.rs` checks every operation of every spec against a local server.
* Google and Microsoft services use an **OAuth credential**: either click *Sign in* in the credential dialog (browser opens,
  loopback redirect on port 53682, PKCE; the refresh token is stored for you) or paste a refresh token. Access tokens are
  minted and cached automatically (`oauth.rs`, `oauth_flow.rs`).
* Native protocol nodes (cargo features `int-mysql`, `int-mqtt`, `int-rabbitmq`, `int-ssh`, `int-ftp`, `int-kafka`,
  `int-mongodb`, `int-image`): compile-checked, not exercised against live servers.
  Limits: FTP is plain (no TLS) and SFTP is not supported; SSH runs commands only; Kafka has no consumer groups; MQTT receive
  is poll-style; MongoDB is desktop/server only; Edit Image does resize/crop/rotate/blur/convert (PNG, JPEG, GIF first frame,
  WebP lossless); Spreadsheet File handles CSV only (no XLSX/ODS).
* Read/Write Files from Disk is limited to your home folder, the temp folder and `HOKKABAZ_FILE_ROOTS`, and is off on Android.

## Missing (from the ranked list)
box, facebookGraphApi, gmailTrigger, microsoftSql, nextCloud, lc:vectorStoreQdrant

Known limits of the declarative nodes: Shopify lists return the first 250 rows; Twitter/X, LinkedIn and Salesforce need an
OAuth app you register yourself (client id/secret). Drive/Dropbox/OneDrive support file upload and download.
